Today, Apple TV released a trailer for the fifth season of Stillwater, a Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness series on the platform. Check out the video below.

Stillwater returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for Stillwater season five, with all five episodes dropping simultaneously on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of Stillwater will include more "breathing exercises, mindful moments, and simple everyday practices," continuing the show's mission of helping children and families find inner calm.

Stillwater originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won the Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing for a Preschool Animated Program and a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.
